summary: Targeted regression on the aliko@yopmail.com Customer Portal end-to-end flow (register-gated on prior orders, mixed order-status can_review filter, verified-purchase review write, duplicate-review 409, sign-out/sign-in, awaiting-review counter). Backend: 6 new pytest cases (test_aliko_portal_flow.py) + 13 pre-existing (test_customer_portal.py) = 19/19 pass. Frontend: full Playwright E2E through Customers → My Orders Portal → register → review → sign-out → sign-in — every spec item verified (screenshot captured). No defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/portal/orders returns {orders:[...], total:N} but existing test_customer_portal.py appears to consume it as a flat list — worth verifying schema stability. The wrapped shape is what the frontend actually uses; my new tests handle both shapes to be safe.
App.js still >2600 lines (flagged in iteration_1) — CustomerPortal + PortalDashboard components would benefit from being extracted.

Console emits 4× recharts width/height=-1 warnings on initial dashboard load — cosmetic only, not blocking. Same warning was likely present in iteration_1 (chart container mounted while sidebar collapses).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 10 spec items verified via Playwright + screenshot

test_credentials: aliko@yopmail.com / secret123 (customer_accounts row is created on first register; my fixture cleans it up + deletes any aliko review rows on setup/teardown so re-runs are idempotent).
seed_data_creation: None — used the 3 pre-seeded orders for aliko@yopmail.com (delivered Apple Watch, paid Scanpan, pending Artusi). Portal customer + review are created during the test and cleaned up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal customer accounts live in db.customer_accounts (NOT db.portal_customers). GET /api/portal/orders returns {orders:[...], total:N} — unwrap the .orders key. Portal register returns 409 if the account already exists (message is 'An account with this email already exists — please sign in'). Sonner toast text on review success is exactly 'Review posted — thanks!'. Star testids are star-1..star-5 (not star-rating-*). All portal testids verified working: nav-customers, cus-portal, portal-tab-login/register, portal-email/password/submit, portal-signout, portal-order-<id>, portal-write-review-<id>, review-title/body/submit/cancel, star-1..5.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Only issues encountered were in my own test scaffolding (wrong collection name portal_customers vs customer_accounts, and orders response wrapper shape) — both fixed before final run.
